commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_HEAD=d5ea880f00048ea7b6c12ea2b4d54e8f2dca8026; EXPECTED_FIRMWARE=0cbd181f46661423d1983ad1805f11d6fecc5128; PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; git fetch --quiet origin mvp/environment-controller; REMOTE_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller); echo "EXPECTED_HEAD=$EXPECTED_HEAD"; echo "REMOTE_SHA=$REMOTE_SHA"; test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; git reset --hard "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; source scripts/source_idf.sh; PROBE=$(esptool.py --port "$PORT" chip_id 2>&1); echo "$PROBE"; grep -q "ESP32-S3" <<<"$PROBE"; OUT=/tmp/stage27c-flash-fallback-20260903-v3; rm -rf "$OUT"; .venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 180 --progress-seconds 30 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_FIRMWARE" --strict; cat "$OUT/summary.json"; .venv/bin/python - "$OUT/soak.ndjson" <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
assert len(rows) >= 15, f'too few soak rows: {len(rows)}'
assert all(r.get('firmware_sha') == '0cbd181f46661423d1983ad1805f11d6fecc5128' for r in rows), 'unexpected firmware identity'
backends=[r.get('storage_backend') for r in rows]
assert backends[0] == 'none', backends
assert all(b == 'flash' for b in backends[1:]), backends
assert all(int(r.get('storage_sd_mounted', -1)) == 0 for r in rows), 'SD unexpectedly mounted during fallback gate'
assert int(rows[0].get('storage_flash_mounted', 0)) == 0, 'flash unexpectedly mounted before first enqueue'
assert all(int(r.get('storage_flash_mounted', 0)) == 1 for r in rows[1:]), 'flash backend not stable after startup transition'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_flash_mount_errors', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'flash mount errors observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_write_errors', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage write errors observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_queue_drops', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage queue drops observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_records_skipped', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage records skipped observed'
fallbacks=[int(r.get('storage_fallbacks', 0)) for r in rows]
assert max(fallbacks) >= 1, fallbacks
written=[int(r.get('storage_records_written', 0)) for r in rows]
assert written[-1] - written[1] >= 2, written
print('STAGE27C_FLASH_FALLBACK_OK', {'rows':len(rows),'backends':backends[:3],'fallbacks':max(fallbacks),'records_written_first_flash':written[1],'records_written_last':written[-1]})
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
